render_contract: sections[] = {domain,label,principles[{id,title,statement,detail (drop-down),disposition,disposition_label,stance,provenance}]}. The silence-taxonomy section ALSO carries stance_groups[] = [{stance:fillable,...},{stance:acknowledge,...}] each with label+blurb+principles[] — render it as TWO groups (Fillable = acquisition targets; Acknowledge = honest limits). Plus badge_table[] (the access_tier field-table: label · precedence · definition · derives_from). design-SB: build principles.html FROM this; statement=always-visible, detail=drop-down. Do NOT hardcode (§2.13, §2.16).

principles.title: Sub-tradition silence
principles.statement: A tradition represented by a single proxy voice while its internal diversity — schools, regions, dissent — goes unrecorded.
principles.detail: Trouillot moment: assembly/canon. The corpus DR's intra-tradition flattening + proxy silence. LACUNA fills it: the clavis names the sub-traditions; the recall audit finds which have zero corpus witness, and the acquisition engine harvests them (Parity Principle §2.10).
principles.provenance: corpus silence DR (silence_DR.txt / silence_fable.txt / silence_gpt.txt, 2026-08-02..03; Trouillot's 4 moments); PI S159 CLC lock (fillable vs acknowledge)

principles.title: Language / translation silence
principles.statement: Knowledge that exists in only one or two languages sits artificially remote from every tradition that cannot read it.
principles.detail: Trouillot moment: retrieval + assembly. Translation is never neutral; the languages a work is available in narrow the archive. LACUNA fills it: non-Western claves (Coptic/Ethiopic/Armenian/Syriac) + translation harvest. The acquisitions feed now carries a lang field so the gap is legible.
principles.provenance: corpus silence DR (silence_DR.txt / silence_fable.txt / silence_gpt.txt, 2026-08-02..03; Trouillot's 4 moments); PI S159 CLC lock (fillable vs acknowledge)

principles.title: Geographic / Global-South silence
principles.statement: Regions outside the Anglophone-European core are thin because indexing, infrastructure, and digitization concentrate elsewhere.
principles.detail: Trouillot moment: retrieval. LACUNA fills it: the Parity Principle fires SciELO · Redalyc · AJOL for ANY query, so majority-world scholarship surfaces with equal priority (the C4 source stack). The pilot-100 found the wall is INVERTED — majority-world is often MORE open (diamond-OA) than Anglophone feminist/womanist work.
principles.provenance: corpus silence DR (silence_DR.txt / silence_fable.txt / silence_gpt.txt, 2026-08-02..03; Trouillot's 4 moments); PI S159 CLC lock (fillable vs acknowledge)

principles.title: Canon / genre silence (public-domain-recoverable)
principles.statement: Works outside the received canon or in low-prestige genres are excluded — recoverable whenever they are public-domain.
principles.detail: Trouillot moment: canon formation. The non-canonical gospels are the worked example: Peter, Nicodemus, the Epistle of the Apostles held as primary text once the PD edition is found; Judas/Philip gated by modern-translation copyright. LACUNA fills the PD slice; the copyright residue becomes an ACKNOWLEDGE silence (see copyright).
principles.provenance: corpus silence DR (silence_DR.txt / silence_fable.txt / silence_gpt.txt, 2026-08-02..03; Trouillot's 4 moments); PI S159 CLC lock (fillable vs acknowledge)

principles.title: Voice / social-position silence
principles.statement: Whose account is absent — women, the enslaved, the laity — even when the tradition itself names them.
principles.detail: Trouillot moment: fact creation. LACUNA fills what it can: the Gospel of Mary (Magdalene as first witness), feminist/womanist exegesis (the pilot-100's most-walled slice). Where the voice was never recorded at all, it crosses into an ACKNOWLEDGE silence (orality, survivorship).
principles.provenance: corpus silence DR (silence_DR.txt / silence_fable.txt / silence_gpt.txt, 2026-08-02..03; Trouillot's 4 moments); PI S159 CLC lock (fillable vs acknowledge)

principles.title: Temporal-freeze silence
principles.statement: A living tradition frozen at one historical edition, its contemporary practice and reinterpretation unrepresented.
principles.detail: Trouillot moment: retrospective significance. The archive freezes a tradition at whatever edition got digitized. LACUNA fills it: acquire contemporary editions + reception. The counter-risk is treating a 1900 translation as the tradition's present voice.
principles.provenance: corpus silence DR (silence_DR.txt / silence_fable.txt / silence_gpt.txt, 2026-08-02..03; Trouillot's 4 moments); PI S159 CLC lock (fillable vs acknowledge)

principles.title: Descriptive / metadata silence
principles.statement: Thin or missing metadata makes a held work unfindable and uncodeable — present in the store, absent from retrieval.
principles.detail: Trouillot moment: assembly + retrieval. A work you hold but cannot describe is functionally silent. LACUNA fills it: metadata backfill (Haiku classification, ~3-5K rows/hr) populates significance/artifact/language so held text becomes reachable.
principles.provenance: corpus silence DR (silence_DR.txt / silence_fable.txt / silence_gpt.txt, 2026-08-02..03; Trouillot's 4 moments); PI S159 CLC lock (fillable vs acknowledge)

principles.title: OCR / machine-legibility silence
principles.statement: Degraded scans and non-Roman scripts yield unreadable text — the work is present but illegible.
principles.detail: Trouillot moment: digitization. The Severus of Antioch case: the Syriac-original scans OCR'd to gibberish, so we used the 1903 English translation. LACUNA fills it: better OCR or finding a clean edition; until then the illegible scan is flagged, never counted as a usable witness.
principles.provenance: corpus silence DR (silence_DR.txt / silence_fable.txt / silence_gpt.txt, 2026-08-02..03; Trouillot's 4 moments); PI S159 CLC lock (fillable vs acknowledge)

principles.title: Orality / performance silence
principles.statement: Knowledge transmitted only through speech, memory, ritual, or the body was never text and cannot be fully textualized without distorting it.
principles.detail: Trouillot moment: fact creation. LACUNA NAMES it and partners (record contemporary holders, tag emic vs etic, mark where a tradition says 'this cannot be written') — but never claims to have captured it. Textualizing orality is itself a distortion; the honest move is to mark the boundary.
principles.provenance: corpus silence DR (silence_DR.txt / silence_fable.txt / silence_gpt.txt, 2026-08-02..03; Trouillot's 4 moments); PI S159 CLC lock (fillable vs acknowledge)

principles.title: Material-survival / survivorship silence
principles.statement: What physically did not survive — burned libraries, decayed media, unpreserved formats — is gone; the archive is a survivorship-biased remnant.
principles.detail: Trouillot moment: assembly. LACUNA marks the loss (a named absence, not a void) but cannot fill it. The corpus is what survived, not what existed; saying so is the trustworthiness move.
principles.provenance: corpus silence DR (silence_DR.txt / silence_fable.txt / silence_gpt.txt, 2026-08-02..03; Trouillot's 4 moments); PI S159 CLC lock (fillable vs acknowledge)

principles.title: Custodial / colonial-collection silence
principles.statement: Works held elsewhere by colonial collection or restricted custody are catalogued by their holders, not by their communities.
principles.detail: Trouillot moment: assembly. LACUNA names the custody + provenance; access and repatriation are not ours to grant. The map records where a work IS and whose it is — the honest limit is that holding ≠ belonging.
principles.provenance: corpus silence DR (silence_DR.txt / silence_fable.txt / silence_gpt.txt, 2026-08-02..03; Trouillot's 4 moments); PI S159 CLC lock (fillable vs acknowledge)

principles.title: Governance / protected-knowledge silence (CARE)
principles.statement: Sacred, protected, or community-restricted knowledge is withheld by right — a silence we respect, not one we repair.
principles.detail: Trouillot moment: fact creation (strategic/sacred). Distinct from a copyright wall: this is the community's governance, not a legal barrier. LACUNA tags requires_care_review and routes to outreach as a DOCUMENTATION pathway (§2.11 CARE — default INCLUDE+TAG, but the restriction itself is honored, never overridden).
principles.provenance: corpus silence DR (silence_DR.txt / silence_fable.txt / silence_gpt.txt, 2026-08-02..03; Trouillot's 4 moments); PI S159 CLC lock (fillable vs acknowledge)

principles.title: Copyright / access silence
principles.statement: A work behind a legal wall we cannot hold — made visible as CITED-NOT-HELD via the fallback ladder, never a blank void.
principles.detail: Trouillot moment: retrieval/access. The IRR230 lock (C1-C10): split rights_blocked from not_yet_found; the source stack + the fallback ladder + the discovery_attempt log + the access_tier badge. An ACKNOWLEDGE silence with the richest remediation — the wall is reported as a strength (C5), not hidden.
principles.provenance: corpus silence DR (silence_DR.txt / silence_fable.txt / silence_gpt.txt, 2026-08-02..03; Trouillot's 4 moments); PI S159 CLC lock (fillable vs acknowledge)

principles.title: Mediated-voice / surrogate silence
principles.statement: A voice reaching us only through a mediator, translator, or OA surrogate — the claim preserved, the primary words unheard.
principles.detail: Trouillot moment: fact creation + retrieval. The IRR230 C3 lock: a surrogate carries the CLAIM, never the VOICE; it is mediation-flagged and BARRED from fine-grained coding (diction, rhetoric, move-structure). LACUNA names the mediation so a mediated observation is never mistaken for a primary one.
principles.provenance: corpus silence DR (silence_DR.txt / silence_fable.txt / silence_gpt.txt, 2026-08-02..03; Trouillot's 4 moments); PI S159 CLC lock (fillable vs acknowledge)

principles.title: Copyright-walled ≠ silenced
principles.statement: A work we cannot legally hold is CITED-NOT-HELD, never a blank void; the wall is made VISIBLE.
principles.detail: The through-line all 5 IRR230 cohorts affirmed. The fix is a graduated fallback that keeps the work discoverable + cited. UNANIMOUS.
principles.provenance: IRR230 reconciliation (research/00_irr/irr230_copyright_fallback_ladder_reconciliation_2026-08-03.md); S159 CLC walk

principles.title: Split rights_blocked from not_yet_found
principles.statement: A copyright wall (external legal barrier) and a discovery gap (internal bibliographic one) are DIFFERENT silences and are counted separately.
principles.detail: The sharpest IRR230 consensus (5/5). Conflating them corrupts the whole audit; they need different remediation. Distinct access_tier values.
principles.provenance: IRR230 reconciliation (research/00_irr/irr230_copyright_fallback_ladder_reconciliation_2026-08-03.md); S159 CLC walk

principles.title: A surrogate carries the claim, never the voice
principles.statement: An OA secondary summary preserves WHAT was claimed, not the primary author's words; it is fenced with a mediation flag + a reader marker, and mediated observations are BARRED from fine-grained coding (diction, rhetoric, move-structure).
principles.detail: UNANIMOUS. Surrogacy prevents disappearance but introduces a named silence: the primary voice remains unheard. Never equal evidentiary weight to primary-text coding.
principles.provenance: IRR230 reconciliation (research/00_irr/irr230_copyright_fallback_ladder_reconciliation_2026-08-03.md); S159 CLC walk

principles.title: The source stack
principles.statement: Discovery/metadata: OpenAlex + Crossref → green-OA: Unpaywall + CORE → BASE/DOAJ → majority-world (CRITICAL): SciELO · Redalyc · AJOL → OA-theological libraries (Globethics, Dict. of African Christian Biography).
principles.detail: UNANIMOUS ranking. SciELO/Redalyc/AJOL are the only reliable route to liberation/African scholarship the Anglophone indexes miss.
principles.provenance: IRR230 reconciliation (research/00_irr/irr230_copyright_fallback_ladder_reconciliation_2026-08-03.md); S159 CLC walk

principles.title: Report the wall as a strength
principles.statement: The public badge shows held / cited-not-held / rights-blocked with the denominator = the WARRANTED reference set (not just holdings), every barrier named, and WHICH works are blocked (so bias-patterns show).
principles.detail: UNANIMOUS. Do not combine direct + mediated into one 'covered' number; expose the composition. Turns copyright into a visible variable in the archive's sociology, not an excuse.
principles.provenance: IRR230 reconciliation (research/00_irr/irr230_copyright_fallback_ladder_reconciliation_2026-08-03.md); S159 CLC walk

principles.title: The fallback ladder (rungs)
principles.statement: Rungs: green-OA fulltext → author-permission → fair-use excerpt (policy-governed, above surrogate) → OA surrogate → cited-metadata → research-access-only (ILL/TDM: read+code, NOT host). DROP Controlled Digital Lending + HathiTrust-emergency (legally unsafe: Hachette v. Internet Archive 2023).
principles.detail: EXTEND. Author-permission is high-value for majority-world/theology voices. Fair-use excerpt is more faithful than surrogate → ranks above it, but as a policy-governed layer with a justification field. TDM/ILL create a read+code-not-host state that MUST be flagged so it is never mistaken for 'held'.
principles.provenance: IRR230 reconciliation (research/00_irr/irr230_copyright_fallback_ladder_reconciliation_2026-08-03.md); S159 CLC walk

principles.title: The discovery_attempt log
principles.statement: Every silence carries a structured log of which rungs were tried, when, and why each failed — NOT a ladder rung but a parallel audit trail.
principles.detail: EXTEND. This is what makes 'rights-blocked' CREDIBLE + replicable (a reviewer sees the good-faith trail). Same idea as CRADLE's per-row source-tried log (§2.8).
principles.provenance: IRR230 reconciliation (research/00_irr/irr230_copyright_fallback_ladder_reconciliation_2026-08-03.md); S159 CLC walk

principles.title: Pilot-100 before locking the numbers
principles.statement: The access_tier SHAPE is locked; the DISTRIBUTION + badge messaging are DEFERRED until a pilot on ~100 real post-1950s works (feminist/liberation/majority-world) maps how many fall into each tier.
principles.detail: DEFER-with-plan. Is rights_blocked 2% or 40%? That reshapes viability + messaging + whether surrogates even exist for the works we care about. Runs once the C4 source-stack is wired.
principles.provenance: IRR230 reconciliation (research/00_irr/irr230_copyright_fallback_ladder_reconciliation_2026-08-03.md); S159 CLC walk

principles.title: Majority-world de-dup (source_system)
principles.statement: Every record carries a source_system field; fuzzy-match (title+author) de-dup is built when regional harvest scales — so the DOI-poor SciELO/Redalyc/AJOL corpus (the one we care most about) is not double-counted or missed.
principles.detail: DEFER-with-plan. Adopt the source_system principle now; the fuzzy-match de-dup follows the Parity-enabled regional harvest.
principles.provenance: IRR230 reconciliation (research/00_irr/irr230_copyright_fallback_ladder_reconciliation_2026-08-03.md); S159 CLC walk

principles.title: access_tier = orthogonal store + derived display tier
principles.statement: Access is multi-dimensional (a work can be held AND green-OA AND surrogate-represented AND license-restricted). Store SEPARATE fields (accessibility · holdings · reuse-basis · representation · voice-directness · barrier-reason) and DERIVE the single badge word from a fixed precedence.
principles.detail: Reconciles GPT (orthogonal fields — the 5 values aren't mutually exclusive) with the badge's need to stay scannable, via Claude's bridge = the §2.13 pattern (rich store → rendered view). The badge is computed, stored nowhere → cannot drift. See access_tier_label for the badge vocabulary + precedence.
principles.provenance: IRR230 reconciliation (research/00_irr/irr230_copyright_fallback_ladder_reconciliation_2026-08-03.md); S159 CLC walk

principles.title: Attribution + provenance on every row
principles.statement: Every source + finding carries where/how it was harvested (extraction_provenance), what shaped it (methodology_notes), and what wrote it (description_author); these are never NULL.
principles.detail: CLAUDE.md §2.4. The honesty substrate — a claim you cannot trace is a claim you cannot defend.
principles.provenance: IRR230 reconciliation (research/00_irr/irr230_copyright_fallback_ladder_reconciliation_2026-08-03.md); S159 CLC walk

principles.title: Cite the external authority, don't enumerate from memory
principles.statement: A silence is a set-difference against a NAMED external authority (a clavis); the LLM matches/normalizes, it never enumerates from memory. Every silence carries the authority's citation (clavis_number).
principles.detail: The LACUNA rigor principle (design-doc U1/U5). The difference between a demo and an instrument.
principles.provenance: IRR230 reconciliation (research/00_irr/irr230_copyright_fallback_ladder_reconciliation_2026-08-03.md); S159 CLC walk

principles.title: CARE — default INCLUDE + TAG, never silence
principles.statement: Indigenous/marginalized data is INCLUDED and TAGGED (requires_care_review), routed through outreach as a DOCUMENTATION pathway — never excluded or deferred. CARE shapes how we describe, not whether we include.
principles.detail: A standing project principle (CLAUDE.md §2.11). Distinct from the copyright wall: 'blocked' for CARE ≠ 'rights_blocked' for copyright. Enforced by a sprint invariant + a pre-recommendation gate.
principles.provenance: IRR230 reconciliation (research/00_irr/irr230_copyright_fallback_ladder_reconciliation_2026-08-03.md); S159 CLC walk

principles.title: Review before you hunt (the pre-hunt gate)
principles.statement: Before claiming a corpus gap or building a harvester, check the three real discovery surfaces — never a naive title-LIKE probe (title-word-dependent → false negatives).
principles.detail: Run scripts/analysis/library_gap_check.py --keywords "…" --tradition PREFIX --resolver substr. It queries (1) TAXONOMY (sources.tradition_id/tradition_family — the correct held-count), (2) CONTENT (passages_fts MATCH — full-text, title-independent), (3) RESOLVERS (cradle_endpoints + the ~200 source_resolvers). Verdict: HELD / RUN-GAP / REAL-GAP. Prevents the S168 failure — "spirituals 0 held" from a title-probe when passages_fts MATCH 'spiritual' = 377,059 and spirituals_corpus.py already existed.
principles.provenance: Librarian S168; §2.9 exhaust-inventory-first + §13 ghost-protection

principles.title: RUN existing → FIX broken → BUILD new
principles.statement: Order acquisition work by that priority; weight by gap-fill ROI × uniqueness, NOT technical ease. With ~200 resolvers + ~400K sources, most "gaps" are run-gaps, not build-gaps.
principles.detail: Grep the resolvers + cradle_endpoints before building (§2.9). A FIX (repair a broken resolver — e.g. the S168 AODL/PARADISEC endpoint repairs) usually beats a BUILD. Full ranking: LWS_harvester_priority_bang_for_buck_s168.
principles.provenance: Librarian S168; feedback_pick_what_hurts_to_build + §2.10 FOUNDRY

principles.title: The acquisition-run checklist
principles.statement: Every acquisition honors the same checklist: pre-hunt gate → dry-run first → PD-only full-text (copyright ladder) → dual-store + verify parity → stagger vs coders → chunk + spot-check → provenance + voice_basis → land as a PR.
principles.detail: Reusable scripts that embody these (copy, don't reinvent): library_gap_check (the gate); ingest_pacific_pd_texts / ingest_suppressed_reception_pd (curated-PD ingest); ia_fulltext_harvester_s168 (archive.org full-text, beyond Gutenberg); harvest_aodl_oral_primary_voice (bulk-blob); reconcile_neon_requires_care_review (dual-store column reconciliation); reclassify_pac_bucket (rule-based reclassification). Toolkit: LWS_reusable_apparatus_and_prehunt_checklist_s168.

badge_table.label: held
badge_table.definition: We hold the full text locally (ingested + chunked).
badge_table.note: The top rung; a held work may ALSO be green-OA / surrogate-represented — those live in the fields.

badge_table.label: open
badge_table.definition: Full text is publicly accessible open-access (we link, may also hold).
badge_table.derives_from: content_access = full_text_public AND reuse_basis in (public_domain, open_licence)

badge_table.label: research-access
badge_table.definition: A lawful copy we can READ + CODE but not host (ILL / TDM exception).
badge_table.note: Must be flagged so it is never mistaken for 'held' (C7).

badge_table.label: cited · surrogate
badge_table.definition: Not held; the claim is carried by a secondary OA summary (mediation-flagged).

badge_table.label: cited · metadata
badge_table.definition: Not held; DOI + metadata (± licensed abstract) only, no full text or surrogate.

badge_table.label: rights-blocked
badge_table.definition: Identified + confirmed copyright-walled; no legal access found (attempts logged).
badge_table.derives_from: barrier_reason in (copyright, licence, paywall) AND discovery = located

badge_table.label: not-yet-found
badge_table.definition: Not yet located — a discovery gap, NOT a copyright wall.
badge_table.note: The other half of the C2 split.

badge_note: The badge word is DERIVED (not stored) by walking this precedence over the orthogonal access fields — the top rung achieved. Stored nowhere → cannot drift (Decision 213, C6).
